historical_experiment_check.anti_repeat_boundary: This is not a notional, hold-day, max-candidate, source, benchmark gate, LLM, or core allocation retune. It is a single threshold sweep because numeric threshold changes require evidence.

historical_experiment_check.exp-20260517-015: Rejected stricter benchmark gate. This run does not retest benchmark participation; it tests candidate-level excess return versus SPY.

hypothesis: Within the accepted rotation_breakout_leadership state-surface paper sleeve, candidates that trail SPY over the prior 20 sessions are weaker replacement-value bets. A nonnegative ret20_excess_spy floor should let stronger same-day candidates fill the paper queue while keeping the candidate source fixed.
interpretation: A nonnegative 20-day return excess versus SPY improved the default-off rotation state-surface paper sleeve without reducing selected trade count or breaching concentration/drawdown guards.
